versionwatch-desc: Checks MediaWiki, PHP, the database server, extensions and skins for available updates
versionwatch-summary: This page compares the installed software with its upstream releases and repositories. Results are stored, so they only change when a check runs.
versionwatch-no-report: No check has run yet. Use the button above, or schedule php maintenance/run.php VersionWatch:checkVersions --problems-only to run daily.
versionwatch-stale: This report is more than a week old. Check that the scheduled VersionWatch:checkVersions job is still running.
versionwatch-attention-security: {{PLURAL:$1|One component needs|$1 components need}} attention, {{PLURAL:$2|one of them|$2 of them}} for security fixes.
versionwatch-attention-none: Everything that could be checked is up to date.
versionwatch-settings-intro: Choose where to look up updates for $1. Settings are saved on [[MediaWiki:VersionWatch.json]], so every change shows up in its page history.
versionwatch-settings-not-installed: No extension or skin named $1 is installed.
versionwatch-settings-part-of: $1 is part of $2. Change the setting for $2 instead.
versionwatch-settings-invalid: The current setting on [[MediaWiki:VersionWatch.json]] cannot be understood. Saving this form replaces it.
versionwatch-settings-path-help: Leave empty to use $1. On GitHub, enter owner/repository.
versionwatch-settings-branch-help: Leave empty to use $1 on Wikimedia Gerrit, or the default branch on GitHub.
versionwatch-settings-invalid-path: This is not a valid repository path.
versionwatch-settings-invalid-branch: This is not a valid branch name.
versionwatch-upgrade-lts-until: It is a long-term support release, supported until $1.
versionwatch-upgrade-shorter-support: Your current version is supported for longer, until $1.
versionwatch-upgrade-php-ok: It needs PHP $1, which this server has ($2).
versionwatch-upgrade-php-missing: It needs PHP $1, but this server has $2.
versionwatch-upgrade-blocking: {{PLURAL:$1|One extension or skin is|$1 extensions or skins are}} not ready for MediaWiki $2.
versionwatch-upgrade-none-blocking: Every extension and skin that could be checked is ready for MediaWiki $2.
versionwatch-upgrade-note-no-branch: There is no $1 branch, so it is not maintained for MediaWiki $2. Look for a replacement before upgrading.
versionwatch-upgrade-note-no-manifest: There is no $1 on the $2 branch.
echo-pref-tooltip-versionwatch: Notify me when installed software, such as extensions, needs updating.
notification-header-versionwatch-update: {{PLURAL:$1|An update is|$1 updates are}} available for $2{{PLURAL:$3|0=|, and one more|, and $3 more}}.
notification-header-versionwatch-update-: {{PLURAL:$1|A security update is|$1 security updates are}} available for $2{{PLURAL:$3|0=|, and one more|, and $3 more}}.
versionwatch-note-bad-response: $1 returned a response that could not be read.
versionwatch-note-unknown-product: No release information is available for this software.
versionwatch-note-supported-until: This release branch is supported until $1.
versionwatch-note-eol-passed: Support for this release branch ended on $1.
versionwatch-note-eol: This release branch is no longer supported.
versionwatch-note-commits-behind: {{PLURAL:$1|One newer change|$1 newer changes}} on the $2 branch.
versionwatch-note-security-changes: {{PLURAL:$1|One newer change|$1 newer changes}} on the $2 branch, including {{PLURAL:$3|a security fix|$3 security fixes}}.
versionwatch-note-core-security: MediaWiki $1 includes {{PLURAL:$2|a security fix|$2 security fixes}}.
versionwatch-note-requires: The update needs $1 $2, but this wiki has $3.
versionwatch-note-only-ignored-commits: {{PLURAL:$1|Only one newer change, which does not count as an update: a translation update or a change to development tools.|Only $1 newer changes, which do not count as updates: translation updates or changes to development tools.}}
versionwatch-note-no-branch: The upstream repository has no $1 branch. The extension may be unmaintained, or use a different branch, which you can set with the change link.
versionwatch-note-repo-not-found: Repository $1 was not found on $2. Use the change link to set where it lives, or to stop checking it.
versionwatch-note-invalid-setting: The setting for this extension on [[MediaWiki:VersionWatch.json]] is invalid.
versionwatch-note-part-of: Part of $1, and updated together with it.
versionwatch-note-commit-not-found: Your copy ($1) does not match anything upstream. It may be a fork or have local changes.
versionwatch-note-no-version: Not installed from git, not bundled with this MediaWiki version, and declares no version, so there is nothing to compare.
versionwatch-note-no-upstream-version: The upstream branch declares no version to compare with.
versionwatch-note-github-rate-limit: The GitHub rate limit was reached. Set $wgVersionWatchGitHubToken to raise it.
right-versionwatch: View and run update checks for installed software
action-versionwatch: view and run update checks for installed software
grant-versionwatch: View the update status of installed software
apihelp-query+versionwatch-summary: Get the latest update report of [[Special:VersionWatch]]. It does not run a new check.
apihelp-query+versionwatch-param-prop: Which parts of the report to get.
apihelp-query+versionwatch-paramvalue-pr: How many components there are per status, and how many need attention.
The status of MediaWiki, PHP, the database server, and each extension and skin.
Whether the extensions and skins are ready for the newest MediaWiki release, if that is on a newer release branch.
